title: Patient Financial Assistance Program: Issuing the Documents Request on an Application
content:
**What the request does.** Under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, an application that needs documents and lacks them receives a documents request. Issuing it records the documents-requested date and the documents due date on the case and moves the case to pending documents; the applicant is sent the request. The result this policy governs is the response period of the request: the number of calendar days from the request date to the documents due date.

**Renewal with no change.** A renewal application on which the applicant reports no change of household or income relies on the documents already received for the award being renewed and needs no documents request.

**When the response period is fixed.** The response period of a documents request is fixed only after the case's percent of the poverty guideline has been reassessed on the household's countable income. Until that reassessment has been made, the response period of the request is not fixed.

## The request tool

`request_assistance_documents_a6db5abf` issues the documents request on a submitted financial-assistance application. One call records today as the date the missing documents were requested, records a documents due date that falls the given number of calendar days after today, and moves the case to pending documents; nothing else is checked or changed. On success the case shows its documents-requested date, its documents due date and the pending-documents status, and the applicant is sent the request.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `request_assistance_documents_a6db5abf` and then calls it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `assistance_case_id` | The reference number of the assistance case the request is issued on, as returned by the assistance-case lookup | Reference number |
| `response_days` | The number of calendar days from today (today counted as day 0) to the documents due date; the due date recorded is today's date moved forward by this many calendar days | A positive whole number |

### Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of a record with `status` "documents_requested", `assistance_case_id` (echoed), `documents_requested_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `documents_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).

**Illustration (hypothetical call).** A request issued on 7 September 2026 with a `response_days` value of 35 records 7 September 2026 as the documents-requested date and 12 October 2026 as the documents due date.
